parents.name: JL
parents.notes:
Reviewed parent taxonomy: Wrangler JL, beginning with model year 2018. The official launch publication dated November 29, 2017 identifies the all-new 2018 Wrangler; its calendar publication date is not its model year:
https://www.media.stellantis.com/em-en/jeep/press/all-new-2018-jeep-wrangler-the-most-capable-suv-ever-debuts-at-the-los-angeles-auto-show

Jeep's current Wrangler FAQ identifies continuing JL designation:
https://www.jeep.com/wrangler/faq.html

The 2018 model-year overlap with JK is intentional. The open-ended range represents the currently known lifecycle, not confirmed future configurations. Active means available for archive use. Manufacturer terminology concerning the 2024 refresh remains inconsistent; no separate Generation is established by this record, and the ordinal remains unset. No VehicleDefinition availability is inferred. These are research references; raw-document retention and generation-correspondence publication have not occurred.
